title: finance-budget-1on1-prep-priya-2026-q2
content:
Meeting prep: 1:1 with CFO (30m) - focus: run-rate, vendor approvals, upcoming renewals, headcount spend

Agenda:
- Quick run-rate check (5m)
- Current overspend flags and root causes (5m)
- Procurement requests requiring approval (10m)
- Contract renewals & negotiation priorities (5m)
- Decisions & next steps (5m)

Quick run-rate snapshot (as of 2026-02-27):
- Monthly run-rate (baseline after adjustments): $4.8M/month
- YoY variance: +18% due to infra scaling and Dedicated capacity onboarding
- Key drivers this quarter: Dedicated clusters (GPU spend), SRE contractor hours, data-transfer egress on EU region
- Cash runway impact: ~2.9 quarters at current burn; target extend to 4.0 quarters by end of Q3 via cost actions

Top overspend line items (root causes):
1) Dedicated GPU pool over-commit (estimated extra $220k/quarter) - cause: conservative buffer & initial autoscale misconfig
2) Cloud egress in EU region (estimated $85k/quarter) - cause: cross-region traffic from analytics pipelines
3) On-demand inference spikes (peak episodes) causing preemptible to fall back to expensive instances ($60k/quarter)

Procurement approvals required (for discussion):
- Contract: Nimbus GPUs (reserved nodes) - spend request: $420,000 for a 12-month reserved commitment. Expected savings vs on-demand: ~32% and improves predictability. Approval needed: CFO sign-off and Legal review. Owner: Eng Infra (Alex Kim).
- SaaS: DataPipelinePro enterprise license - $48,000 annual. Needed for analytics SLA; alternative: extend current month-to-month with reduced support. Owner: Analytics (Maya Kapoor).
- Professional services: SRE support retainer (Q2-Q3) - $75,000. Rationale: ensure rollout of private deployments without incident. Owner: SRE (Jordan Lee).

Contract renewals timeline (next 60 days):
- Storage vendor (StorFast) renewal 2026-04-15 - current auto-renewing month-to-month; propose converting to 12-month at $210k (savings vs month-to-month uncertain).
- Monitoring provider (TraceWave) renewal 2026-03-20 - negotiating volume discount; need decision on retention levels (cost/obs tradeoff).

Negotiation priorities & asks for CFO:
- Approve Nimbus GPUs reserved commit subject to Legal SLA review and 30-day exit clause.
- Approve one-time SRE retainer for Q2 ramp; revisit in Q3 based on private-deployments telemetry.
- Greenlight limited spend freeze target list (non-critical marketing & travel) to shave $120k/quarter starting Apr 2026.

Questions for CFO (to surface in 1:1):
- Appetite for front-loading reserved capacity to secure lower unit costs vs preserving cash runway?
- Any tolerance for a short-term bridge to support Private deployments ramp (approve SRE retainer + reserved GPU commit)?
- Do we want to prioritize optimizing egress (engineering) vs accepting as a region growth cost?

Proposed decisions (I will ask for these in the meeting):
- Approve Nimbus 12-month reserved commit up to $420k contingent on Legal SLA + 30-day partial exit.
- Approve SRE retainer $75k for Q2 with milestones (0 incidents in 90 days on Private rollout baseline).
- Approve DataPipelinePro only if we can negotiate first-year discount to < $40k.

Follow-ups & action items (post-1:1):
- Priya: Draft approval memo and attach vendor T&Cs for CFO signature - due 2026-03-05.
- Alex Kim: Provide risk matrix for reserved GPU commit (cost delta scenarios + exit mechanics) - due 2026-03-04.
- Maya Kapoor: Consolidate telemetry showing egress pattern by service & propose mitigation (caching, colocating) - due 2026-03-10.
- Jordan Lee: Provide SRE retainer scope & milestones doc and estimated deliverables - due 2026-03-04.
- Legal: Initial review of Nimbus SLA (Priya to route) - target 2026-03-06.

Notes to self / rough talking points:
- Emphasize predictability benefit (Dedicated reserved nodes) and tie to SLAs for key customers; show cost sensitivity analysis (if we buy 12-month vs 6-month vs on-demand).
- Be ready to push back on non-essential spend; propose immediate freeze list of ~$120k/quarter with concrete line items.
- Ask CFO whether finance prefers capex-looking reserved commits or operational smoothing via credits.

Appendix (numbers & sources):
- Run-rate derived from FY26 forecast v2 (tab: spend_by_service) - see linked artifact CONFLUENCE-BUDGET-2026.
- Vendor quotes: Nimbus quote id NIM-2026-02-15; DataPipelinePro quote DP-2026-02-20; SRE retainer estimate docs stored in /shared_drives/finance/vendor-requests (will attach).

Quick checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Attach vendor quotes to approval memo
- [ ] Confirm Legal contact availability for SLA review
- [ ] Bring 1-slide cost delta (12m vs 6m vs on-demand)
- [ ] Prepare fallback ask if CFO says no to reserved commit (short-term burst credits)
